sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Teams WHERE year = 2006 AND W > L AND Pts > 100
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 1995 AND name IN ('Florida Panthers', 'Edmonton Oilers', 'Los Angeles Kings') ORDER BY CAST(PKC AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.W FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' AND T1.oppID = 'BOS' AND T1.year = 1985

SELECT T3.name FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.oppID = T2.tmID JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T1.year = 2000 GROUP BY T3.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.W + T1.L + T1.T + IFNULL(CAST(T1.OTL AS INTEGER), 0)) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.PIM FROM TeamsSC AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year = 1918
SELECT T2.W FROM TeamsSC AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.PIM = '24'
SELECT SUM(CAST(T1.W AS REAL) / T1.G) / COUNT(*) FROM TeamsSC AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.coachID) FROM Coaches AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID JOIN Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE lastName = 'Green' AND playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NULL
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.ENG = '10' ORDER BY CAST(T1.height AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.tmID) FROM Master AS T1 JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.lastName = 'Young'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'BOS' AND T2.year = 1972 AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL AND T1.hofID IS NULL

SELECT T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM Goalies AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID JOIN Master AS T3 ON T1.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T2.name = 'Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY SUM(CAST(T1.GA AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2005 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2006 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2005 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) FROM Goalies AS T1 JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.firstName = 'David' AND T2.lastName = 'Aebischer'
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY playerID HAVING AVG(height) = 75
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(weight AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NOT NULL AND playerID IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID FROM Master AS T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.Pts), T2.coachID FROM Teams AS T1 JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.tmID = 'ANA' GROUP BY T2.coachID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.playerID, T2.tmID FROM Master AS T1 JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND T1.playerID = (SELECT M.playerID FROM Master AS M JOIN Scoring AS S ON M.playerID = S.playerID WHERE S.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND M.height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(M.height AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL) / T1.G, T2.playerID FROM Teams AS T1 JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.year = 1998 AND T1.tmID = 'CAR' ORDER BY T2.G DESC LIMIT 1
